locator: II.A.2.g.3, printed p. 27, Altersgruppen 1 and 2. All-age control II.A.2.b, printed p. 14
published_scope: Kingdom of Bavaria including the Palatinate, population present
definition: The 1903 yearbook publishes the 1900 census. The original complementary minority and majority rows give ages below 21 and from the completed 21st year onward. Their counts sum to the census population present. The table does not give a separate unknown-age count for these rows.
uncertainty: Changes in age and sex shares over the 334 days between opening and enumeration are unquantified. The two source age bands are retained without finer allocation.

locator: I.B.8, printed p. 7, column 2, Ortsanwesende überhaupt
definition: The 1904 yearbook publishes the 1900 census by age and marital status. This column gives the age counts for both sexes combined, including 6,741 persons of unknown age. The table does not publish a sex cross-tabulation.
